descriptors.concept_name: Payment in respect of life insurance policy [Section 194DA]
descriptors.definition: Tax is deductible on maturity or other proceeds of life insurance policies that fail to satisfy statutory exemption conditions. The deduction applies to the income component after subtracting the premium paid.
inclusion: maturity proceeds of policies not qualifying for exemption
bonus amounts allocated under such policies
exclusion: payments below the prescribed financial year threshold limit
nearby_distinctions: Unlike fully exempt policies under Section 10(10D), policies failing conditions attract tax deduction on the net income element.

descriptors.concept_name: Payments in respect of deposits under National Savings Scheme, etc. [Section 194EE]
descriptors.definition: A person responsible for paying amounts from a National Savings Scheme Account must deduct tax at the specified rate upon payment. Payments made to legal heirs are exempt from these tax deduction requirements.
inclusion: withdrawals from National Savings Scheme accounts
exclusion: payments disbursed to the legal heirs of the assessee
nearby_distinctions: Section 194EE specifically governs NSS account withdrawals, differing from general bank deposit interest provisions.

descriptors.concept_name: Commission etc. on the sale of lottery tickets [Section 194G]
descriptors.definition: Payers distributing income by way of commission, remuneration, or prize on lottery tickets must deduct tax at source. Crediting a suspense or similar account is deemed a credit to the payee's account.
inclusion: commission on lottery ticket sales
remuneration and prizes relating to lotteries
exclusion: payments not exceeding the statutory threshold limit
nearby_distinctions: Distinct from general commission or brokerage under Section 194H, Section 194G specifically targets lottery-related earnings.

descriptors.definition: Specified payers making payments by way of commission or brokerage to a resident must deduct tax at source. Professional services are explicitly excluded from the scope of this provision.
inclusion: payments for services rendered in the course of buying or selling goods
transactions relating to assets or valuable articles other than securities
nearby_distinctions: Differs from insurance commission which is covered under a separate section, and excludes professional services governed under Section 194J.

descriptors.definition: Entities responsible for paying rental income for the use of land, buildings, machinery, plant, equipment, furniture, or fittings to a resident must deduct tax at source. Real estate assets owned directly by a REIT are exempt from this deduction.
inclusion: payments for land or buildings
rent for plant, machinery, equipment, furniture, or fittings
exclusion: rent paid to a business trust being a REIT in respect of directly owned real estate assets
nearby_distinctions: Applies distinct tax rates for plant, machinery, and equipment rental compared to land, building, and furniture rental.

descriptors.concept_name: Payment on transfer of certain immovable property other than agricultural land [Section 194-IA]
descriptors.definition: Transferees acquiring immovable property other than rural agricultural land from a resident must deduct tax from the consideration or stamp duty value. Compulsory acquisitions are excluded as they fall under alternative provisions.
inclusion: consideration for transfer of land other than rural agricultural land
buildings or parts of buildings
incidental charges like club membership and parking fees
nearby_distinctions: Unlike compulsory property acquisitions covered under Section 194LA, standard voluntary property transfers fall under Section 194-IA.

descriptors.concept_name: Payment of rent by certain individuals or Hindu undivided family [Section194-IB]
descriptors.definition: Individuals and Hindu Undivided Families not subject to regular tax audit thresholds who pay monthly rent exceeding a specified amount must deduct tax at source. The deduction is capped at the rent payable for the last month of the previous year or tenancy.
inclusion: monthly rental payments exceeding the threshold by qualifying individuals and HUFs
exclusion: individuals and HUFs subject to business or profession audit turnover limits
nearby_distinctions: Specifically targets non-business or smaller individual and HUF tenants rather than corporate or large business entities.

descriptors.definition: Payers distributing consideration under a registered real estate development agreement involving land or buildings must deduct tax at source. This mechanism applies specifically to specified agreements governed by capital gains provisions.
inclusion: monetary consideration paid under registered land development agreements
exclusion: consideration paid entirely in kind or transfers covered under general immovable property sections
nearby_distinctions: Supersedes general immovable property transfer TDS for arrangements qualifying as specified agreements under Section 45(5A).

descriptors.concept_name: Fees for professional or technical services [Section 194J]
descriptors.definition: Entities other than individuals and HUFs paying fees for professional or technical services, royalty, non-compete fees, or director remuneration must deduct tax at source. Threshold limits apply independently to professional fees, technical fees, royalties, and non-compete payments.
inclusion: fees for professional or technical services
royalty payments
non-compete fees
director remuneration
exclusion: payments below the distinct threshold limits per category
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes separate threshold evaluations for professional fees, technical fees, royalties, and non-compete compensation.

descriptors.definition: Payers distributing income in respect of mutual fund units or specified undertakings must deduct tax at source. Capital gains distributions and amounts below the financial year threshold are exempt from this deduction.
inclusion: income distributed on mutual fund units
units from administrators of specified undertakings or specified companies
exclusion: income of the nature of capital gains
aggregate income not exceeding the threshold limit in a financial year
nearby_distinctions: Excludes capital gains components, focusing strictly on income distributions from specified mutual fund and corporate units.

descriptors.concept_name: Payment of compensation on acquisition of certain immovable property [Section 194LA]
descriptors.definition: Payers disbursing compensation or consideration for the compulsory acquisition of immovable property other than agricultural land must deduct tax at source. Awards exempted under specific land acquisition transparency legislation are excluded.
instrument_references: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
inclusion: compensation and enhanced consideration for compulsory property acquisition
exclusion: awards exempted under Section 96 of the Land Acquisition Act 2013
nearby_distinctions: Restricted exclusively to compulsory acquisitions under statutory laws rather than voluntary real estate transfers.

descriptors.concept_name: Payment made by an individual or a HUF for contract work or by way of commission or brokerage or fees for professional services [Section 194M]
descriptors.definition: Individuals and HUFs not subject to regular business audit requirements who pay substantial sums for contract work, commission, brokerage, or professional services must deduct tax at source. Taxpayers already obligated to deduct tax under specific contractor, commission, or professional sections are excluded.
inclusion: contract work payments
commission or brokerage
fees for professional services made by non-audit individuals and HUFs
exclusion: individuals and HUFs required to deduct tax under Sections 194C, 194H, or 194J
nearby_distinctions: Serves as a catch-all provision for individual and HUF payees who exceed high financial thresholds but lack business audit obligations.
